description:
Aggregator parent POM for the eleven-proof library. Coordinates four modules - core (API
    contracts), services (generators and validators), generated (OpenAPI models), and
    application (CLI) - that together generate and validate Dutch identifiers (BSN, bank
    account, Giro) using the eleven-proof rule.
    Source code, issues, and contributions: https://github.com/sayfjawad/eleven-proof-lib
